verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa withdrew from The Players Championship in March 2026 due to a sudden back injury.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "withdrew from THE PLAYERS after just one hole of his first round" (R1); "pulled out of The Players Championship after one hole last month when he injured his back while swinging" (R2); "withdrew after playing just one hole at The Players Championship... suffering a back injury" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm withdrawal from The Players due to back injury; March 2026 strongly implied by 'last month' prior to April Masters.

verifications.claim: The back injury was specifically described as a back spasm felt during a practice swing on the 11th tee during the first round.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "took one practice swing and I just knew it was gone... muscle spasm" on "11" (R3); "back spasms" (R1); "practice swing on the second hole" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly supports spasm on 11th tee practice swing; R1 supports spasms; R5 contradicts with 'second hole', creating conflicting hole details.

verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa described the injury as a recurring, severe issue that made it impossible to swing through, forcing his withdrawal.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "I've had this stuff before"; "not being able to swing"; "couldn't get through impact"; "the worst thing in the world" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly quotes Morikawa describing prior occurrences, inability to swing, and severity leading to withdrawal.

verifications.claim: The injury was a back injury/spasms triggered during a practice swing on the 11th tee at TPC Sawgrass.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "practice swing... on 11"; "back injury"; TPC Sawgrass (R3); "practice swing on the second hole" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: R3 supports back injury/spasms on 11th tee practice swing at Players (TPC Sawgrass); R5 contradicts hole number ('second hole').

verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa withdrew from the Valero Texas Open to recover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "withdrew before the event began" from Valero (R1); "withdrew before the event began" (R2); same (R4, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm pre-event withdrawal from Valero due to the back injury recovery.

verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa returned for the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Describes first round play at 2026 Masters (R1); "hopes to tee it up at Augusta... Thursday's opening round" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm participation and performance in first round of 2026 Masters post-injury.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: April 8, 2026 (R2); first round context in April 2026 (R1)
verifications.reasoning: Explicit dates in sources place 2026 Masters in April.

verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa stated he was "taking it day by day".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote from Morikawa in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa stated that the injury did not worsen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the injury didn't get worse since he first suffered it during the first round of The Players Championship" (R2)

verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa stated that he had to manage residual effects and mental hurdles.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "aftereffects of back spasms"; "debilitating mental scars"; "mental block" (R1); "mental battle just trying to trust" (R2, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly quote Morikawa on mental battles and ongoing body issues post-injury.

verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa indicated he underwent MRIs.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Morikawa had MRIs done on his back in recent weeks" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated in context of Morikawa discussing his injury.

verifications.claim: Collin Morikawa indicated he focused on rest and rehab to ensure the injury did not create further, long-term setbacks.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Morikawa is at home resting"; "Rest and recovery is a priority... should not create further setbacks" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: R3 mentions resting at home and broadcaster update on rest/recovery preventing setbacks, indirectly indicating Morikawa's approach but not direct quote on rehab or long-term focus.
